newsitem.title: USA: Manpower Q4 revenue up as Europe steadies.
newsitem.headline: Manpower Q4 revenue up as Europe steadies.

text.p: Manpower Inc on Thursday said its fourth-quarter performance improved after more normal operating environments returned in Europe, where economic weakness and weak currencies had held back the company's growth.

The temporary staffing services company said revenues in the fourth quarter rose to $1.6 billion $1.4 billion in the final period of 1995. Net income rose to $48.1 million, or $0.58 a share, from $36.6 million, or $0.45.
Manpower said the results included after-tax income of $4.8 million, or $0.06 a share, from the sale of assets.
Manpower shares were up 4-3/4 to 34-3/4 in early afternoon trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
